# Working Effectively with Legacy Code for Codex

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/legacy-code/ in the guided-plugins repository.

- Skills: 29 workflow and rule skills plus 6 mode skills, invoked as `$legacy-code:<name>` or from `/skills`.
- Subagents: 20 roles in `../agents/legacy-code-*.toml`. Codex plugins cannot bundle subagents, so install them with `node scripts/install-codex-agents.mjs legacy-code`.
- Always-on rules: see `../../rules/legacy-code/`.

Full instructions: docs/AGENTS_SUPPORT.md in the repository.
